name: ModelVariant386_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant386_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 0x3C-byte command row indexed by the request, gets one slot part per configured strand plus an extra part and packs its texture images before setting up the strands, sheets and three chains, otherwise it runs one frame (strands once the phase is positive, sheets every frame, chains from phase 5) and returns 4 in phases 5-6, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every image that builds the entry; the French, German and Italian images build it through french_model_variant/variant403_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the PAL palette x; HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
